rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a fair-quality Day 5 blastocyst and the reported 4BB grade, but includes speculative image-based details (collapse, warming/cooling effects, hatching transition) and some inconsistency with the provided expansion description.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, tubal factor, semen parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle well, with appropriate emphasis on age-related aneuploidy as the main limiting factor.
Reasoning is mostly logical and structured, linking morphology and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include some hedging and slight inconsistency around exact morphology and outcome ranges.

Recommendations are broadly aligned with IVF practice guidelines: single embryo transfer, caution about hydrosalpinx, limited use of add-on testing, and nuanced discussion of PGT-A. Minor deviations include some speculative comments not strictly guideline-based.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including luteal support, hydrosalpinx review, SET, and when to consider PGT-A or sperm DNA fragmentation testing; useful though not highly tailored to missing cycle-specific details.
